convertibility_reason: Uses two external .mqh libraries (MyMQL_v2.1.mqh, PrintLog.mqh) that provide critical trading functions (GetInfoPosition, LotControl, ContrType, PrCur) not defined in the EA source. Also implements multi-symbol hedging/pairs trading logic with global variable persistence and time-based protection code that obfuscates behavior.

indicators.name: Price Deviation (Pairs Spread)
indicators.derived_period: Compaction = (High_Win - Low_Win) / (H - L) over Range bars

derived_values.name: Compaction coefficient
derived_values.formula: (High_Win - Low_Win) / (H - L) where H,L are high/low of Symbol2 over Range bars

derived_values.name: CurrentDeviation
derived_values.formula: (iClose(Symbol,Period,Candle) - Compaction*(iClose(Symbol2,Period,Candle) - L) - Low_Win) / Point(), negated if Correlation<0

derived_values.name: lot2 (indirect instrument lot)
derived_values.formula: NormalizeLot(lot1 * Compaction * TV, Symbol2) where TV = Symbol1_tick_value / Symbol2_tick_value

derived_values.name: NeedLot (signal strength lot)
derived_values.formula: n * (SPS.sLot / SPS.sCount) if positions exist, else n * Calculate_Lot()

other_exits: Close when deviation crosses zero (spread convergence - positions oppose deviation direction)
Close when |CurrentDeviation| < CloseCorr * MaxDeviation AND PointProfit > 0 (partial mean-reversion with profit lock)
Correlation-aware close: for Correlation>0, close BUY base/SELL indirect when CurrentDeviation>0 (convergence), and vice versa
For Correlation<0, close BUY both / SELL both when deviation reverses sign

position_sizing.conditional_logic: LOT_TYPE=0: fixed lot reduced to 90% of free margin if insufficient; LOT_TYPE=1: lot = equity * LOT / margin_per_lot. For pairs: lot2 = lot1 * Compaction * tick_value_ratio. Signal strength n = round(|CurrentDeviation|/MaxDeviation), capped at MaxDeals. NeedLot = n * base_lot_per_position. lot1 = NeedLot - existing_lot.

custom_logic_notes: This is a statistical arbitrage / pairs trading EA. It trades the deviation between two correlated instruments (e.g. EURUSD vs GBPUSD). The Compaction coefficient normalizes the price ranges of both instruments so deviations are comparable. Entry: when |CurrentDeviation| exceeds MaxDeviation (signal border) and deviation is increasing (|LastDeviation| < |CurrentDeviation|). For Correlation>0: buy base/sell indirect on negative deviation, sell base/buy indirect on positive deviation. For Correlation<0: buy both on negative deviation, sell both on positive deviation. If Cross parameter is set, trades only the cross pair instead of both legs. Includes obfuscated time-based protection (lines 119-128) that modifies Signal based on last digit of Bid price when not testing and after Sep 2011. Global variables persist optimization state across restarts. Retraining occurs every Optimum bars.
python_conversion_notes: This EA requires two-symbol data simultaneously for deviation calculation. Must implement: (1) Compaction normalization between two instruments, (2) Deviation = normalized spread in points, (3) Signal border from historical max deviation * CorrectLimit, (4) Correlation-aware direction mapping for hedged positions, (5) Tick value ratio for cross-instrument lot sizing, (6) The external MyMQL_v2.1.mqh functions (GetInfoPosition, LotControl, ContrType, PrCur) must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented. The time-based protection code (lines 119-128) should be excluded as it appears to be demo-limitation code. GlobalVariableGet/Set usage needs replacement with persistent state mechanism. Signal strength n scales position size proportionally to deviation magnitude (grid-like scaling up to MaxDeals).
